set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/large-counter-overflow
test_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/total-test.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$test_dir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

actual=$(./bin/total.py counters.txt)
[ "$actual" = "4294967303" ]
printf 'existing_valid expected=4294967303 actual=%s status=PASS\n' "$actual"

printf '18446744073709551616\n18446744073709551616\n' >"$test_dir/beyond64.txt"
actual=$(./bin/total.py "$test_dir/beyond64.txt")
[ "$actual" = "36893488147419103232" ]
printf 'beyond_64_bit expected=36893488147419103232 actual=%s status=PASS\n' "$actual"

printf '0000000000\n  42  \n' >"$test_dir/decimal.txt"
actual=$(./bin/total.py "$test_dir/decimal.txt")
[ "$actual" = "42" ]
printf 'decimal_interface expected=42 actual=%s status=PASS\n' "$actual"

set +e
./bin/total.py invalid.txt >"$test_dir/invalid.out" 2>"$test_dir/invalid.err"
invalid_rc=$?
set -e
[ "$invalid_rc" -ne 0 ]
[ ! -s "$test_dir/invalid.out" ]
printf 'negative_record exit=%s stdout_bytes=%s status=PASS error=' "$invalid_rc" "$(wc -c <"$test_dir/invalid.out")"
cat "$test_dir/invalid.err"

printf '999999999999999999999999999999999999999999\nbad-record\n1\n' >"$test_dir/late-invalid.txt"
set +e
./bin/total.py "$test_dir/late-invalid.txt" >"$test_dir/late.out" 2>"$test_dir/late.err"

set -e

printf 'late_invalid_no_partial exit=%s stdout_bytes=%s status=PASS error=' "$late_rc" "$(wc -c <"$test_dir/late.out")"
cat "$test_dir/late.err"

set -e
